title: KP Group — Government of Botswana renewable energy and power infrastructure MoU, 2025
description: "Government of the Republic of Botswana and KP Group Sign MoU to Collaborate on Large Scale Renewable Energy and Power Infrastructure Development" — a regulatory filing by KPI Green Energy Limited to the Bombay Stock Exchange dated 17 December 2025, envisaging ~5GW of renewable energy, storage and transmission capacity.
recipient_organisation: Ministry of Minerals and Energy, Government of Botswana

title: World Bank — Botswana Renewable Energy Support and Access (RESA) project, 2025
description: World Bank Project Implementation Support Mission Aide Memoire (9–17 February 2026) for the Renewable Energy Support and Access (RESA) Project (P181221): "Preparation: February 2024; Appraisal: May 2024; Negotiations: May 2024; Board: July 2024; Signing: June 3, 2025; Effectiveness: December 3, 2025; 1st disbursement: December 23, 2025." Implementing counterparts named: Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Minerals and Energy, Botswana Power Corporation, Botswana Energy Regulatory Authority.

title: Chinese Government donates video conferencing equipment to Botswana's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation worth $2.8 million
description: On May 22, 2015, China donated video conferencing equipment valued at about $2.8 million to Botswana's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation. The equipment was supplied by Huawei and was installed at the ministry headquarters and Botswana's high commission in Pretoria, South Africa.
